title: Debug
unavailable: Not supported in the current environment

app.title: App
app.description: Read app details, state, launch URL, and language, and observe lifecycle, deep-link, and restored-result events. Minimizing is Android-only.

appLauncher.title: App Launcher
appLauncher.description: Check whether a URL or app can be opened, then ask the system to open it. Custom iOS schemes and Android 11+ queries require allowlist configuration.
appLauncher.urlPlaceholder: Enter a URL, scheme, or Android package

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Write test logs at each level. View them in My > Logs.
logs.debugMessage: This is a debug test log
logs.infoMessage: This is an info test log
logs.warnMessage: This is a warn test log
logs.errorMessage: This is an error test log
logs.errorDetail: A test error for verifying error-detail serialization

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Read and write lightweight string key/value data and inspect all stored keys. The web implementation falls back to localStorage.

share.title: Share
share.description: Check sharing support or open the system share sheet with text and a link.
share.contentText: Shared from the app debug page

device.title: Device
device.description: Read the device identifier, system information, battery state, and system language.

statusBar.title: Status Bar
statusBar.description: Read status bar information and test dark, light, hide, and show actions. This plugin is native-only.

splashScreen.title: Splash Screen
splashScreen.description: Show the splash screen for two seconds with automatic hiding, or hide it manually. This plugin is native-only.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Test native Toast durations and positions. Toasts always appear at the bottom on Android 12 and newer.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Test native alert, confirmation, and text input dialogs and inspect their results.
dialog.alertMessage: This is an alert example from Capacitor Dialog.
dialog.promptMessage: Enter a name for this demonstration.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Control the software keyboard and observe show and hide events. Showing is Android-only; appearance and layout controls are iOS-only.
keyboard.inputPlaceholder: Tap here to open the keyboard
keyboard.iosControls: iOS accessory bar and page scrolling

haptics.title: Haptics
haptics.description: Test impact, notification, vibration, and continuous selection feedback. The device provides the effect supported by the system.

screenOrientation.title: Screen Orientation
screenOrientation.description: Read and observe the screen orientation, lock it to portrait or landscape, and restore the system orientation.

textZoom.title: Text Zoom
textZoom.description: Read and adjust the WebView text zoom level, or restore the system-preferred font scale.

actionSheet.title: Action Sheet
actionSheet.description: Open a native action sheet and return the selected button index and cancellation state.
